# busy-office-ui v0.1.1

> CSS-first UI framework for ERP and back-office applications. Semantic components,
> density as a dimension (data-density="compact|comfortable|spacious" on <html> or any
> wrapper), dark mode via [data-theme="dark"], all framework CSS in @layer (unlayered
> consumer CSS always wins). Browser floor: Chrome/Edge 119, Firefox 128, Safari 17.4.

## Install

npm i @busy-office/ui
import "@busy-office/ui/css";                      # all-in-one
# a la carte, ORDER MATTERS: tokens -> reset -> components
import "@busy-office/ui/css/tokens"; import "@busy-office/ui/css/reset";
import "@busy-office/ui/css/components/data-table";

## JS behaviors (call each ONCE — document delegation survives all DOM swaps)

import { initDialogs, initDataTables, initTabs, initDropdowns, initAlerts,
         refreshDataTable, trapFocus } from "@busy-office/ui/js";
- initDialogs(): REQUIRED for <dialog class="bo-dialog"> + [data-dialog-trigger].
- initDataTables(): select-all, live "n selected" count, O(1) toolbar reveal;
  re-derives on htmx:afterSwap; refreshDataTable(container) for other swaps.
- initTabs(): REQUIRED for tabs (roving tabindex, RTL-aware arrows).
- initDropdowns(): anchors [popover] menus to their invoker; close-on-select.
- initAlerts(): .bo-alert__dismiss removes its alert/toast.

## Behavior hooks (generated — the DOM each init reads)
- initDialogs(): Dialog behavior via event delegation — no per-element binding, no DOM flags [hooks: data-dialog-trigger data-dismissible data-state]
- initDataTables(): Optional table behavior (~1 kB): wires select-all, keeps an O(1) data-any-selected attribute on the container (so CSS needn't re-scan every row via :has() on large grids), and maintains a live "n… [hooks: bo-data-table-container bo-data-table__row-select bo-data-table__select-all bo-data-table__selection-count data-any-selected]
- refreshDataTable(): Optional table behavior (~1 kB): wires select-all, keeps an O(1) data-any-selected attribute on the container (so CSS needn't re-scan every row via :has() on large grids), and maintains a live "n… [hooks: bo-data-table-container bo-data-table__row-select bo-data-table__select-all bo-data-table__selection-count data-any-selected]
- initDataGrid(): Opt-in ARIA grid pattern for .bo-data-table (WAI-ARIA APG "Grid", the interactive-widgets variant) [hooks: bo-data-table bo-data-table-container bo-data-table__row-select data-grid-nav]
- refreshDataGrid(): Opt-in ARIA grid pattern for .bo-data-table (WAI-ARIA APG "Grid", the interactive-widgets variant) [hooks: bo-data-table bo-data-table-container bo-data-table__row-select data-grid-nav]
- initRowEdit(): Multi-row inline edit: tracks which rows have unsaved changes, shows a per-row Save/Cancel affordance, and dispatches a `bo:row-save` event for your code to persist (fetch, hx-patch, form submit —… [hooks: bo-badge bo-badge--warning bo-btn bo-btn--sm bo-data-table bo-data-table__row-edit-actions bo-input bo-input--seamless data-row-edit data-row-edit-cancel data-row-edit-dirty data-row-edit-save data-row-id data-row-state]
- initTableToolbar(): Optional data-table toolbar actions: column visibility + export [hooks: bo-btn bo-btn--secondary bo-checkbox bo-data-table bo-data-table-container bo-data-table__toolbar bo-dropdown__menu data-col data-col-toggle data-multiselect data-multiselect-label data-table-export data-table-export-format]
- initTableSum(): Declarative realtime column totals — the auto-sum half of Slice 18's subtotal contract (a deliberate, named exception to "you do the data"; the other half is listening to `bo:cell-change` yourself for… [hooks: bo-data-table__col--numeric data-decimals data-sum-of]
- initLoadMore(): Load-more pagination ("pull up to see more") — the infinite-scroll alternative to page-number `.bo-pagination` [hooks: bo-btn bo-btn--secondary bo-data-table bo-data-table-container bo-data-table__footer bo-pagination data-load-more-auto data-table-load-more]
- initCollapsibleCards(): Collapsible card sections (.bo-widget) [hooks: bo-widget__collapse data-collapse-trigger data-state]
- initSavedViews(): Saved-view / filter-bar persistence [hooks: bo-filter-bar data-saved-views]
- initWizard(): Multi-step wizard flow — one panel visible at a time, with a bo-stepper kept in sync [hooks: bo-stepper bo-stepper__step data-state data-wizard data-wizard-back data-wizard-current data-wizard-next data-wizard-panel data-wizard-submit]
- initQuantity(): Increment/decrement buttons for .bo-quantity — document-level delegation, call initQuantity() once [hooks: bo-money__currency bo-quantity bo-quantity__input bo-quantity__step bo-quantity__unit-select data-decimals data-quantity-step]
- unitDecimals(): Increment/decrement buttons for .bo-quantity — document-level delegation, call initQuantity() once [hooks: bo-money__currency bo-quantity bo-quantity__input bo-quantity__step bo-quantity__unit-select data-decimals data-quantity-step]
- initMoneyField(): Currency-aware money field — a currency <select> linked to an amount input: changing currency updates the input's `step` (decimal precision) and reformats the current value to that precision [hooks: bo-input bo-input--numeric bo-money bo-money__amount bo-money__currency bo-select data-decimals]
- currencyDecimals(): Currency-aware money field — a currency <select> linked to an amount input: changing currency updates the input's `step` (decimal precision) and reformats the current value to that precision [hooks: bo-input bo-input--numeric bo-money bo-money__amount bo-money__currency bo-select data-decimals]
- initScanInput(): RF/handheld barcode-scanner input [hooks: bo-input bo-input--code bo-visually-hidden data-scan-input data-scan-status data-scan-terminator]
- initFileDropzone(): Drag-and-drop convenience for a `.bo-file-dropzone` [hooks: bo-file-dropzone bo-file-input bo-visually-hidden data-dragover data-file-dropzone]
- initTagInput(): Multi-value tag/chip entry (Fiori Token/MultiInput; Ant/Carbon Tag) — multi-tag cost centers on a record, multiple approval-routing recipients [hooks: bo-alert bo-tag-input bo-tag-input__field bo-tag-input__remove bo-tag-input__tag data-grid]
- initValidationSummary(): Inline validation summary [hooks: bo-alert bo-alert--danger data-validation-summary data-validation-summary-box]
- initTabs(): ARIA tabs behavior via document-level delegation — call initTabs() once [hooks: bo-tabs__tab]
- initDropdowns(): Popover-based dropdown menus [hooks: bo-btn bo-btn--secondary bo-checkbox bo-dropdown__item bo-dropdown__menu bo-dropdown__menu--end data-multiselect data-multiselect-count data-multiselect-label]
- initCombobox(): Editable combobox with list autocomplete — WAI-ARIA APG combobox pattern (single-select, list autocomplete, manual selection) [hooks: bo-combobox bo-combobox__listbox bo-combobox__option bo-input data-bo-open data-value]
- initAlerts(): Dismiss behavior for alerts and toasts: any .bo-alert__dismiss button removes its enclosing .bo-alert [hooks: bo-alert bo-alert__dismiss]
- trapFocus(): Loop Tab / Shift+Tab within a container

## Rules your markup must follow

- State is two-channel: visible non-color cue (glyph, aria-hidden) AND programmatic
  (visually-hidden text like "Completed: ", aria-current, ARIA attributes).
- Forms: aria-invalid + aria-describedby -> message id (+ role="alert" if dynamic).
- Dialogs: aria-labelledby -> title id. Icon-only buttons: aria-label.
- Row-select checkboxes need name/value to POST. Styled lists get role="list".
- Sorting: YOUR code re-orders rows and sets aria-sort on <th>; CSS draws indicator.
- Never user-scalable=no. Never override html font-size (rem-based framework).
- Columns hidden by container compaction (__col--secondary) must stay reachable.

## Semantic tokens (re-brand = remap these in UNLAYERED :root; re-set in your [data-theme="dark"] block — unlayered beats the framework's dark remaps)
--bo-border-width --bo-color-accent --bo-color-accent-solid --bo-color-accent-strong --bo-color-accent-subtle --bo-color-accent-text --bo-color-bg-canvas --bo-color-bg-hover --bo-color-bg-muted --bo-color-bg-selected --bo-color-bg-surface --bo-color-bg-surface-raised --bo-color-border-control --bo-color-border-default --bo-color-border-strong --bo-color-danger --bo-color-danger-solid --bo-color-danger-strong --bo-color-danger-subtle --bo-color-danger-text --bo-color-focus-ring --bo-color-success --bo-color-success-strong --bo-color-success-subtle --bo-color-success-text --bo-color-text-disabled --bo-color-text-inverse --bo-color-text-muted --bo-color-text-primary --bo-color-text-secondary --bo-color-warning --bo-color-warning-strong --bo-color-warning-subtle --bo-color-warning-text --bo-density-cell-padding-x --bo-density-cell-padding-y --bo-density-control-height --bo-density-field-gap --bo-density-font-size --bo-density-row-height --bo-focus-ring-offset --bo-focus-ring-width --bo-font-mono --bo-font-sans --bo-font-size-base --bo-font-size-lg --bo-font-size-md --bo-font-size-sm --bo-font-size-xl --bo-font-size-xs --bo-font-weight-medium --bo-font-weight-normal --bo-font-weight-semibold --bo-line-height-normal --bo-line-height-tight --bo-motion-duration-base --bo-motion-duration-fast --bo-motion-duration-slow --bo-motion-easing-standard --bo-radius-full --bo-radius-lg --bo-radius-md --bo-radius-sm --bo-shadow-dialog --bo-shadow-lg --bo-shadow-md --bo-shadow-sm --bo-space-0 --bo-space-1 --bo-space-10 --bo-space-12 --bo-space-2 --bo-space-3 --bo-space-4 --bo-space-5 --bo-space-6 --bo-space-8 --bo-state-active-overlay --bo-state-disabled-opacity --bo-state-error-bg --bo-state-error-color --bo-state-hover-overlay --bo-z-dropdown --bo-z-sticky-col --bo-z-sticky-header --bo-z-toast
